items.title: Pure resolveHintMode leaf (deterministic on/off)
items.context: New core/hint-mode.ts importing only node:crypto/types: resolveHintMode(storyId: string): 'on' | 'off' — deterministic, e.g. parity of the first bytes of sha256(storyId). Same storyId always yields the same arm; roughly balanced across ids. Pure, no fs/git.
items.userSees: A deterministic function that maps a storyId to a stable on/off A/B arm.

happy.desc: resolveHintMode("B-06b3") returns either "on" or "off" (valid HintMode literal); WHY: confirms basic contract
resolveHintMode called twice with same storyId -> returns identical result both times; WHY: determinism proof
resolveHintMode over 1000 synthetic storyIds (B-0001..B-1000) -> both arms appear with roughly 40-60% split; WHY: balance verification
Module exports only resolveHintMode function + HintMode type -> no unexpected exports; WHY: confirms leaf surface area

edge.desc: resolveHintMode("") (empty string) -> returns valid on/off without throwing; WHY: degenerate input must not crash
resolveHintMode with very long storyId (10000 chars) -> returns valid result without hang/OOM; WHY: sha256 handles arbitrary length
resolveHintMode with unicode storyId (B-\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e-001) -> returns valid on/off deterministically; WHY: utf-8 hashing edge
resolveHintMode with storyIds differing by one char (B-06b3 vs B-06b4) -> both return valid results, confirms hash bit sensitivity; WHY: near-collision check

adversarial.desc: Static: hint-mode.ts imports only node:crypto and/or type-only imports -> no fs/git/path/child_process/Date.now/Math.random; WHY: purity enforcement via grep
resolveHintMode called 100 times same storyId across fresh calls -> all identical; WHY: no hidden mutable state or closure drift
Static: hint-mode.ts source has no process.env, fs., require(non-crypto), setTimeout, setInterval, Date references; WHY: pure leaf no side effects
Adversarial: passing null/undefined/number as storyId -> throws TypeError or coerces deterministically, never silently corrupts arm; WHY: type safety boundary

items.title: Shadow-gate the hint section + record hintMode in story-review.ts
items.context: In handlers/story-review.ts experience-hints block (~528-578) and the _reviewPrompt assembly: compute hints as today (loadExperienceHints) regardless of arm; resolve hintMode = resolveHintMode(args.storyId); add hintMode to the experience_hint_surfaced event payload (fires on BOTH arms when hints exist, deduped per round as today); render experienceHintsSection into _reviewPrompt ONLY when hintMode==='on' (OFF arm: the section string used for the prompt is '' so it is hidden, but the event still recorded what would have surfaced). Do NOT change the issues/blocker computation; do NOT let hints enter resolveReviewPromptHash (unchanged); keep the no-hints byte-identical behavior.
items.userSees: ON-arm stories show the advisory experience-hints section in _reviewPrompt; OFF-arm stories do not, yet both still emit experience_hint_surfaced (with hintMode) recording the would-have-hinted set.
